lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Vanakkam sir, Kaveri Finance la irundhu pesaren. Ganesh Murugan sir ah?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sir, verification kaaga unga bike loan account last four digits sollunga.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Three three zero five. என்ன விஷயம்?
lines.roman: Three three zero five. Enna vishayam?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sir, unga account la October, November rendu EMI pending, four thousand six hundred each, plus bounce charges twelve hundred. Total ten thousand four hundred rupees overdue. Yen pay pannala sir?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: என்ன? October EMI நான் branch ல cash ஆ கட்டினேன். Receipt கூட என் கிட்ட இருக்கு. அப்புறம் எதுக்கு bounce charge?
lines.roman: Enna? October EMI naan branch la cash aa kattinen. Receipt kooda en kitta irukku. Appuram edhukku bounce charge?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sir, system la adhu reflect aagala. Pay pannalana CIBIL la report aagum, charges um add aagite irukkum.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Sir நான் சொல்றதை கேளுங்க. October பத்தாம் தேதி Anna Nagar branch ல கட்டினேன். உங்க mistake க்கு நான் ஏன் charge கட்டணும்?
lines.roman: Sir naan solradha kelunga. October patthaam thedhi Anna Nagar branch la kattinen. Unga mistake kku naan yen charge kattanum?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Seri sir, naan idha dispute ah raise panren. Receipt copy WhatsApp la anuppunga. Seven working days la check panni solluvaanga.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Number system la generate aagum sir, SMS la varum. Adhu varaikkum November EMI four thousand six hundred mattum kattiduveengala?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Dispute clear ஆகுற வரைக்கும் ஒண்ணும் கட்ட மாட்டேன். அது வரைக்கும் calls வராதுல்ல?
lines.roman: Dispute clear aagura varaikkum onnum katta maatten. Adhu varaikkum calls varaadhulla?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Adhu naan solla mudiyaadhu sir, regular follow-up calls varalaam.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Okay sir. Appo neenga receipt anuppunga, dispute seven working days la review aagum, adhukku appuram thirumba call panrom. Thank you.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer disputes the October EMI and bounce charges, saying he paid in cash at the Anna Nagar branch and holds a receipt.
analysis.summary: Borrower says the October EMI was paid in cash at the branch on 10 October and the ₹1,200 bounce charges are wrong. Agent raised a dispute with a 7-working-day review but gave no reference number and could not confirm a pause in collection calls.
analysis.observations: Verification, dues breakdown and closing recap were solid. But the agent responded to the dispute by citing CIBIL reporting before hearing the customer out, never gave a reference number, and left the customer expecting continued calls during review, which hurt trust.
analysis.improvements: Acknowledge the cash payment claim before quoting consequences, generate and read out the dispute reference on the call, and confirm that follow-ups on the disputed amount pause during review. Ask what the customer can pay on the undisputed November EMI rather than demanding it in full.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Asked for last four digits of the loan account.

ds_reason_delay.rationale: Asked why the EMIs were not paid.

ds_empathy.rationale: Answered the customer's frustration with CIBIL consequences instead of acknowledging it.

ds_ability_to_pay.rationale: Demanded the full November EMI without asking what the customer could pay.

ng_state_dues.rationale: Stated two missed EMIs, ₹1,200 bounce charges and ₹10,400 total.

ng_consequences.rationale: Mentioned CIBIL reporting and accruing charges factually, though poorly timed.

ng_options.rationale: Offered paying only the undisputed November EMI while the dispute is reviewed.

dp_log_ticket.rationale: Raised the dispute but did not share a reference number despite being asked.

dp_pause_collection.rationale: Said regular follow-up calls may continue during the review.

cp_no_threats.rationale: No threats; consequences stated as facts.

cp_respectful.rationale: Polite throughout, though somewhat dismissive at first.

cp_no_third_party.rationale: Spoke only with the verified borrower.

cl_ptp_secured.rationale: No amount or date committed; customer will not pay until the dispute clears.

cl_payment_mode.rationale: No payment agreed, so payment mode does not apply.

cl_recap.rationale: Recapped receipt submission, 7-day review and callback.

moments.label: Claims October EMI paid in cash
